prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE transparent 2D animation sprite sheet with FOUR COMPLETE CHARACTER drawings in a precisely spaced 2 by 2 grid, read top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Square canvas. Four equal square cells, invisible borders, each character fully inside its own cell with 8% empty margins. No labels, panels, text captions, floor, shadows, background, motion streaks or duplicated body parts. Truly transparent alpha.
Image 1 is the identity/style reference: chibi blue gradient wavy hair, ahoge, blue-white whale ears and blue whale tail, orange asterisk hair clip, cream hoodie with caramel bow and orange sleeve asterisks, small flower patch on pocket, tan pleated skirt and white frill, white flower legwarmers, brown Mary Jane shoes. Preserve identity, head/body ratio, rendering style and camera across ALL FOUR drawings. Badge says exactly "Claude" in black on white, orange rim; do not replace it with a flower. Each pose is a complete organically drawn body, two arms/hands and two legs only. No paper cutout articulation. Character's scale and horizontal center identical in every cell. Action: 待机呼吸休闲, calm front-facing idle with a slow blink. Frame 1: relaxed standing, arms low by sides, eyes fully open, chest at rest. Frame 2: slight gentle inhale, shoulders and hoodie rise naturally by a few pixels, eyelids half closed. Frame 3: eyes softly fully closed in one blink, arms and posture stable, hair ends and whale tail follow breathing slightly. Frame 4: eyes open again, relaxed exhale, shoulders settle back and tail slowly returns. Shoes planted on the SAME baseline in all cells. Small believable breathing motion, no jumping, no whole-character scaling. Keep front view.
